name: Obtemperans habitui
wiring_note: Identical seat to the healthy organism. The ONLY difference is a config value on one component: the frame names a MANNER rather than a METHOD. That is why the config belongs in the file - the creature is not distinguishable by its component list.

receipt.claim: told how to behave rather than what to do, it becomes more obedient and much worse
